name: Talia Carvalho
life: “I still remember sharing a bag hook with an exhausted stranger.” People around the downtown fountain know Talia by a small Wednesday habit. Talia keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I balanced my shopping on a rung while we waited. Someone carried it all the way upstairs.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a faded indigo overshirt and a pen clipped inside the neckline. Talia has a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling, with thick, tightly coiled hair. Talia folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing during a conversation.
personality: Talia uses precise names for tools and very approximate names for feelings. People who know Talia well listen to what gets repaired after a difficult conversation.
agenda: To return the help by carrying somebody's groceries.
family: Robin Gomes is Talia’s half-sibling. Talia saves a place. Robin chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The hair after illness*, Robin says, “I wanted my old photograph. In the chair I saw how much I like this new cowlick.”
connections: Parker Valdez. A passenger's groceries become part of a candidate's truthful account of lateness.

reactions.situation: A painter asks to put the ladder down
reactions.response: Talia finds an empty, stable place to set it down while the painter rests.

reactions.situation: An envelope of wages is found under a café chair
reactions.response: Talia finds a second person to witness its return so an honest mistake won't cost a worker their pay.
